karachi.summary: Hot and humid most of the year, very mild winters, minimal rainfall. High humidity from the coast but low actual rain.

lahore.summary: Hot summers, cool foggy winters, monsoon rain in July-August. Wide temperature swing across the year.

islamabad.summary: Milder than the plains, good monsoon rainfall, cooler winters with occasional light frost. Best climate in Pakistan for roses and temperate flowers.

peshawar.summary: Hot dry summers, cold winters, low rainfall overall.

quetta.summary: High altitude - cool summers, cold winters with frost/snow possible. Very different from the rest of Pakistan; good for fruit trees like apples, grapes.

multan.summary: One of the hottest cities in Pakistan in summer, very dry, mild winters. Needs heat and drought tolerant plants.

faisalabad.summary: Hot summers, cool winters, similar to Lahore but slightly drier.

hyderabad.summary: Very hot summers, dry, mild winters.

murree.summary: Hill station climate - cool summers, snowy winters. Suited to temperate plants that fail elsewhere in Pakistan.

gilgit.summary: Cold high-altitude desert climate. Very different plant palette - stone fruit and cold-hardy species do well.
